approved_findings: Same canonical URL and core API-meter-event subject in both captures (new 1, 5-15; old 1, 4-14). Meter setup precedes events; event name, customer ID, numeric value and optional timestamp remain central; processing and summaries/invoices remain asynchronous (new 9-11; old 8-10).

The current 64-line source summarizes the 35-day acceptance bound without invoice inclusion timing (source 23-27); new 33-35 clarifies that post-finalization acceptance can affect summaries without updating either finalized or next invoice, and threshold invoices use usage received before creation. New dimension-cardinality rules are explicit: 10,000 combinations per meter per receipt hour and 100 per customer on a meter across events; existing combinations continue, newly introduced over-limit combinations are invalid and surface through error_report_triggered / meter_event_dimension_count_too_high (new 41-48). Current source 59-60 only names that error code.

The 1,000-calls-per-second v1 live ceiling is now stated per Stripe account and separate from the global limit, plus one concurrent call per customer per meter (new 52). Sandbox Meter Events and connected-account calls count toward respective global/basic limits; Stripe-Account-header Connect platform requests retain the 100-ops-per-second regular limit (new 54, 63). Current source 28-33 omits the per-account, concurrency and separate-limit distinctions.
